The cloud library could not be reached, so a cloud copy may still be there' and never claims a cloud copy exists. ed895be (A15): tests/a2-pullout.spec.ts (Node-side, stand-in localStorage) pins all five branches including the cloud-configured ones; removing the cloud-only guard turns it red.
